name: DOHMH Childcare Center Inspections (Historical)
description:
This dataset contains historical inspection records for childcare centers regulated by the New York City Department of Health and Mental Hygiene. Each row represents a single inspection event at a licensed childcare program, with 34 columns covering facility identity, location, permit status, program and age-range characteristics, capacity, staffing, and inspection outcomes.

Key fields include the center and legal name, building, street, borough, ZIP code, and phone; permit number, permit expiration, and status (Permitted, Active, or Expired-In Renewal); program type (mostly preschool, with infant/toddler and camp programs), facility type, age range served, and maximum capacity. Inspection details include the inspection date, summary result (such as passed or reinspection required), regulation summary text, violation category (general, critical, or public health hazard), health code subsection, and violation status (corrected or open). The data also provides calculated rates: overall violation rate, public health hazard violation rate, and critical violation rate, along
